recap.text: Lusca, a level 82 Octo-Shark Brood Mother Queen from Hayes 17, drags the Akula down and holds the crawlers in her mouth to feed her babies. Carl uses bloodlust potions to make the babies eat each other, then fires a shell spell that drives Lusca into the ocean floor. Katia Grim uses a twenty-five-foot buzzsaw to cut through Lusca's brain, leaving a Map of the Stars.

beats.headline: Something covering the port
beats.text: The Akula was pulled free of its hole in the necropolis and dragged down past 550 meters, with boss music playing and no boss yet. A sucker the size of half the bridge window pressed against the glass. Then subject came into view: a shark the size of a mountain, glowing, tentacles flowing behind. Crawler Carl identified it as a sharktopus and observed that Princess Donut would be angry to have missed it. His second observation was that this was not good.
beats.gist: A mountain-sized glowing sharktopus presses a sucker against the glass and drags the Akula down.

beats.headline: Straight from Hayes 17
beats.text: A Special Event boss battle, streamed to subscribers, in a new beta format with live commentary from Kevin and Magnificent Troy. It's Lusca, Kevin shouted, taken from the depths of the water moon Hayes 17. My own description, for the record: Octo-Shark Brood Mother Queen, level 82 City Boss, a single mother carrying a boatload of hungry babies in her mouth. The male who dragged the crawlers down already got his and is long gone. Lusca herself already ate. The babies, however, need feeding.
beats.gist: Lusca is a level 82 Octo-Shark Brood Mother Queen from the water moon Hayes 17.

beats.headline: Ten minutes for the babies
beats.text: Subject is a mouthbrooder, per Magnificent Troy's diagram. She had snapped the Akula in half, and the crawlers were floating in her mouth. Once she clamps onto something, her babies get about ten minutes to eat their fill, and whatever is left goes to mama. The cartoon that followed showed the rest of the process in several stomachs, ending with a skeleton in heart-covered boxers and a crying cartoon Donut. Both announcers fell about laughing. A ten minute timer slammed onto the screen.
beats.gist: Lusca is a mouthbrooder who snaps the Akula in half to feed her babies for ten minutes.

beats.headline: The babies turn on each other
beats.text: Juvenile Octo-Shark, level 30, minion of Lusca. In each birthing of two to three thousand pups, one or two survive, because in time they learn their siblings are delicious. Crawler Carl's depth charges landed a direct hit; Kevin said she would shrug them off. Then Crawler Carl set off a potion of bloodlust in the water, the babies went into a feeding frenzy, and the kill markers multiplied. Subject swam on in circles around the quadrant at about 35 kilometers per hour. Crawler Carl wondered whether she knew most of her babies were now dead.
beats.gist: Carl sets off a bloodlust potion, causing Lusca's level 30 Octo-Shark pups to eat each other.

beats.headline: Mama swallows the Akula
beats.text: The timer hit zero and subject raised her head to swallow the Akula whole. At that moment Crawler Carl fired his shell spell down her throat. It did not punch through as intended. She stopped dead in the water, as if she had hit a wall; her upper jaw bent back over her own eyes, cartilage snapping, and teeth shattered as the spell drove her into the ocean floor. Every remaining baby died as the inside of her mouth turned outside. She was grievously wounded. She was not yet dead.
beats.gist: Lusca swallows the Akula, but Carl fires a shell spell down her throat.

beats.headline: Cleaved through the brain
beats.text: Katia Grim fired a rocket and held on to a live twenty-five-foot buzzsaw, and the three crawlers pinwheeled out of subject's mouth and back through her exposed upper snout, cutting her like a hot knife through calamari, until one of her tentacles slammed them into the seabed. Lusca, the Octo-Shark, now floats on her side on the ocean floor, upper jaw peeled back and split, a jagged red line through her tiny little brain. Winner. From her corpse: a Map of the Stars.
beats.gist: Katia Grim fires a rocket and holds a twenty-five-foot buzzsaw to kill Lusca, the Octo-Shark.

beats.headline: The Akula's cheat
beats.text: Addendum. Crawler Carl holds that each of the bubble's four quadrants was built with a cheat, a quick way to kill everything: the knock-knocks under the Wasteland, the hidden drain on the sandcastle, the lightning tower for the final castle. He was never sure what the easy win for the Akula was meant to be. He suspects it had something to do with subject.
beats.gist: Carl suspects the Akula has a cheat to kill everything related to subject.
